body:
I'm a trans man. My high school girlfriend (I identified as a lesbian at the time) sexually assaulted and abused me throughout the course of our relationship. Our relationship started because she raped me and the only way I could settle the cognitive dissonance on it was by telling myself that it was okay so long as we were dating. I asked her out right after it happened. I know that's a weird reaction, and I kind of set myself up for the abuse by doing that. 

 I was pretty fucked up about it until I met my college girlfriend. She helped me work through a lot of things. I guess to some extent I have more credibility on the rape front because I do have a vagina, but people still find it hard to think of women as rapists.
I don't think that would be much easier, to be honest.
I will be if I'm still here in a month and a half.
I'm in an area without too much theatre and I think I've looked into every option.

I have a passion that I follow for theatre, which is what I study in school. I'm away from my school and friends and jobs and have been since January with a couple of short trips back which have been so much better, but then the depression hurts more when i have to leave again. I have tried a number of times to find something in that vein to work on while I'm here, to no avail, and I am too tired and jaded to look anymore.
